verdict.rationale: The Conductor console is documented as a place to monitor and observe workflows, and its HTTP API and dbosctl can read metrics and inspect queues. That means a platform engineer could script metric pulls into their own tooling. Nothing shows native export of failure rates, latencies or queue depths to an external observability stack, and nothing shows alerting. Missing for 10: native metrics/trace export (e.g. OpenTelemetry or Prometheus), explicit failure-rate, latency and queue-depth metrics, alerting rules or notifications on workflow misbehavior, independent corroboration.
